anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Distillate flow drifting down steadily 0.85 -> 0.67, with a one-sample dropout to 0.004 at k=15
Buffer-vessel dP spike to 5.73 then 3.24 mbar vs ~2.0 baseline
System pressure dipped to 396.0 mbar coincident with PDI702 spike, otherwise stable ~399
Column dP low and falling, 0.03 mbar at last event
No temperature sensors installed; reboiler/column thermal state unobservable

args.missing_evidence: Temperature data (unavailable on this column) or a composition/GC sample; whether the falling flows and PDI702 excursion reflect real vapour-load loss (heater/condenser issue, partial blockage) versus flowmeter faults — a controlled reflux setpoint step would discriminate.
